Ramphal ......... Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Haryana And Another ..... Respondents
Coram:
Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Yashvir Singh Rathor

Present : Mr. Parshant Sethi, Advocate
 for the petitioner.
 Ms. Jasmine Gill, Aag, Haryana.
 Ms. Sanyam Khetarpal, Advocate for
 Mr. Sumit Sharma, Advocate
 for respondent No.2.
 ****
Yashvir Singh Rathor, J. (Oral)
1.

Prayer in this petition filed under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 is for
quashing of Fir No.807 dated 12.12.2018 registered at Police Station Meham, District Rohtak
(Annexure P-1) under Sections 420, 467, 468, 470 and 471 of Ipc, 1860 and all subsequent
proceedings arising therefrom on the basis of compromise.

2. This Court vide order dated 04.09.2025 had directed the parties to appear before the Trial
Court/Illaqa Magistrate to get their statements recorded and the learned Magistrate was directed to
send his/her report qua the genuineness of the compromise.

3. Pursuant to the aforesaid order, parties have appeared before learned Additional Civil Judge (Sr.
Divn.)-cum-SDJM, Meham and got 1 of 2 their statements recorded.

On the basis of the statements so recorded, learned Magistrate has submitted report dated 10.10.2025 to the effect that the compromise has been effected between the parties voluntarily and without any coercion or undue influence.
4. Learned State counsel as well as learned counsel for respondent No.2 have not disputed the factum of compromise between the parties.

sentences.text: In view of the above, no useful purpose would be served to continue with the proceedings before the trial Court in the instant F.I.R. following the principles laid down by the Full Bench judgment of this Court in 2007 (3) RCR (Criminal) 1052 titled as 'Kulwinder Singh and others Versus State of Punjab and another' and approved by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in (2012) 10 SCC 303 titled as 'Gian Singh Versus State of Punjab and others', this petition is allowed and all subsequent proceedings arising therefrom on the basis of compromise qua petitioner(s), are hereby quashed.
